description: Call this FIRST when you need a bank code, or for 'which central banks do you cover?' / 'do you have rates from X?'. Returns every covered source — 121 central banks plus 3 tax authorities (HMRC, US Treasury, Swiss BAZG) — with `code` (what get_official_rates takes as `bank`), name, latest publication date and whether it is behind schedule. No API key needed.
name: list_central_banks
title: List covered central banks & tax authorities
